fact: Uganda's Office of the Prime Minister issued Issue 81 of the monthly U-NIEWS multi-hazard early warning bulletin, covering 5 August to 15 September 2023, with a crop and pasture conditions map and NDVI anomaly analysis drawn from remote sensing and rainfall data.
title: U-NIEWS: Monthly National Integrated Multi-Hazard Early Warning Bulletin, Issue 81
publisher: Office of the Prime Minister, National Emergency Coordination and Operations Centre
